name: Taihou Daigaku Byouin no Kyouki  - Dai Yon Ya
original_name: 大鳳大学病院の狂気 第四夜
source:
A wife comes home only to have a chastity belt put on her by a gross man. That was the beginning of an experiment to make her his lover.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE043615.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
妻子回家后却被一个粗俗的男人给她系上了贞操带。这是让她成为他情人的实验的开始。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE043615.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
